_comment: Without this file the hooks are files nobody calls. `hooks/write_block.py`
sat here while the spec listed it as built, and every ship report printed
DEGRADED because nothing had ever fired it.
Copy to .claude/settings.json and set V4_TASK per task. None of these is a
boundary -- all three are friction. A shell defeats any of them, and the
checkers catch at ship what the hooks catch early.
bash_guard 同 write_block 係同一個問題嘅兩半:一個睇 Write/Edit,一個睇 Bash。冇後者,一句 sed -i .v4/config.json 就繞過晒。
root -- 一句 `cd tests/fixtures/...` 之後,`python3 hooks/bash_guard.py` 就搵唔到
自己,而跟住每一個 Bash / Write / Edit 都喺執行之前被拒,連 `cd` 返去嗰個都行唔到。
所以呢個係死結唔係假綠 —— 但一個解唔到嘅死結,同一個關咗嘅閘一樣係冇閘。
Hook 路徑由 git 問出嚟,唔用相對路徑,亦唔用 $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR。
相對路徑實測會鎖死:hook 嘅 cwd 係 shell 嘅 cwd,唔係 repo root —— 一句
`cd tests/fixtures/…` 之後 `python3 hooks/bash_guard.py` 就搵唔到自己,
跟住每一個 Bash / Write / Edit 都喺執行之前被拒,連 `cd` 返去嗰個都行唔到。
$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR 冇用,因為 settings schema 冇為 hook 保證呢個變數,
實測亦讀唔到 —— 一個展開成空字串嘅路徑,同相對路徑一樣係死結。
`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` 由 repo 內任何一層都答得出,而 hook 本來
就只會喺一個 git repo 入面行。fail-closed 唔係靜靜放行,但一個解唔到嘅
死結,同一個關咗嘅閘一樣係冇閘。
而嗰個死結今日出現咗:repo 目錄喺一個開住嘅 session 途中改咗名,`git rev-parse`
由一個唔再存在嘅 cwd 答唔出嘢,路徑塌成 `/hooks/*.py`。PreToolUse 當佢係拒絕,
於是每一句 Bash / Write / Edit 都被擋,連 cd 返去嗰句都擋埋;Stop 反方向,exit 0
當放行,個閘靜靜熄咗。兩個 script 入面嘅 fail-open 由頭到尾冇行過,因為 shell
喺佢哋開始之前已經死咗 —— 一個 hook 保護唔到自己搵唔到自己嗰個情況。
所以路徑照樣由 git 問,問唔到就企定出聲:stderr 一句 + `{}`。呢個就係
hooks/_framework.py 一路嘅做法 —— 接唔到就企定,而企定唔可以靜。
呢度本來仲有一句 `"env": {"V4_REPO": "."}`,而佢就係上面嗰個死結嘅另一半:
hook 路徑由 git 問出嚟,hook 守邊個 repo 就由一個相對值決定,而相對值對住嘅
係 hook 個 process cwd。實測:同一個受保護路徑嘅 Write payload,喺 repo root
拒得到,喺同一個 repo 嘅子目錄行 relative_to 拋 ValueError、返 {} = 放行、
而且一行 hook_seen 都冇寫 —— 一句 cd 就熄咗個閘,兼且喺 ledger 度同「從來冇裝過」
一模一樣。所以呢個 key 冇咗:repo root 而家由 hooks/_framework.py::repo_root
答,而佢同 hook 路徑問同一條問題 —— `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`。一個目錄
只可以做嗰條問題嘅起點,唔可以做佢嘅答案:repo 入面每一個目錄都答到同一個
toplevel,而入面只有一個係 repo。冇 set V4_REPO 就由 hook 自己個檔嗰度起 ——
`v4 install` 會把 hooks/*.py copy 入 adopter,所以個 hook 一定坐喺佢守緊嗰棵
樹入面。仲要指去第二個 repo 嘅話,set V4_REPO,佢一樣係一個起點:`.` 喺子目錄
度指返嗰個子目錄所屬嘅 repo,唔再係嗰個子目錄。

hooks.command: D=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$D" ]; then V4_HOST=claude exec python3 "$D/hooks/write_block.py"; else echo "v4 write_block: no git root; hook did not run" >&2; echo '{}'; fi
D=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$D" ]; then V4_HOST=claude exec python3 "$D/hooks/bash_guard.py"; else echo "v4 bash_guard: no git root; hook did not run" >&2; echo '{}'; fi
D=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$D" ]; then V4_HOST=claude exec python3 "$D/hooks/stop_gate.py"; else echo "v4 stop_gate: no git root; hook did not run" >&2; echo '{}'; fi

D=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$D" ]; then V4_HOST=claude exec python3 "$D/hooks/session_context.py"; else echo "v4 session_context: no git root; hook did not run" >&2; echo '{}'; fi

D=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$D" ]; then V4_HOST=claude exec python3 "$D/hooks/session_context.py"; else echo "v4 session_context: no git root; hook did not run" >&2; echo '{}'; fi
D=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$D" ]; then V4_HOST=claude exec python3 "$D/hooks/stop_gate.py"; else echo "v4 stop_gate: no git root; hook did not run" >&2; echo '{}'; fi
